events.name: tutorial.step.started
events.purpose: Measure entry into each tutorial funnel step.
events.fire_condition: Emit once when the tutorial state machine enters a step for a new attempt.

events.name: tutorial.step.completed
events.purpose: Measure step completion and elapsed time.
events.fire_condition: Emit after the step completion condition is satisfied.

events.name: tutorial.step.abandoned
events.purpose: Locate the tutorial step where an attempt ended early.
events.fire_condition: Emit when an attempt ends before the current step completes.

privacy.data_minimization_note: Use pseudonymous player key; do not add direct identifiers without an explicit requirement.

experiments.name: tutorial_hint_copy
experiments.hypothesis: Clearer tutorial hints increase step completion without increasing time to finish.

experiments.name: tutorial_reward_timing
experiments.hypothesis: Showing the reward earlier increases tutorial completion.
